en: A vintage multi-view postcard with four colored illustrations of landmarks in and around the Dutch city of Nijmegen. The upper left view shows a park landscape with lawns, trees, a round brick tower and distant church-like buildings, labeled as Kronenburgerpark. The upper right view depicts a green park or estate with tall trees, a villa and a smaller white chapel-like building, labeled Koepel Wester Meerwijk. The lower left image shows a broad town square framed by multi‑story historic buildings and pedestrians, labeled Groote Markt. The lower right image portrays an ornate Renaissance-style brick weighing house with a steep roof and exterior staircase opening onto a busy square, labeled de Waag. Each view is captioned with the word 'Nijmegen.' in red script at the top.
